scope: Homes in Rio camera 3; no production or catalogue changes
method: Compared the saved live screenshot with the operator's published view description and geodesic landmark bearings from the approximate Chopin building coordinate. Bearings use initial geodesic azimuth. Pixel-to-landmark identity is not sufficiently certain for optical calibration.

origin.note: Edifício Chopin centroid approximation. Exact camera lens position and height are unpublished.

evidence.supports: Identifies the Chopin building and describes the camera as directed northeast toward Leme beach and Sugarloaf. This is broad orientation evidence, not optical metadata.
Landmark coordinate source cited by the prior review for Morro da Urca and Pão de Açúcar.
Morro do Leme summit location; used only as a geospatial cross-check, not as evidence of camera direction.
Screenshot saved and examined at imagePath.

cameras.imageObservation: Frame shows Copacabana shoreline receding to the left, open Atlantic on the right, and a rocky headland/massif on the horizon. More than one ridge silhouette is visible, but the screenshot alone does not securely distinguish Morro do Leme, Babilônia, Urca, and Sugarloaf peaks at pixel-level. Do not label the tallest silhouette as Sugarloaf solely from the operator description.

geographicReferences.uncertainty: feature centroid is not a surveyed summit point
summit coordinate from topographic reference; feature extent makes exact sightline uncertain

cameras.bearingBasis: The operator's northeast description plus the mapped landmark sightlines from the building define a broad NE sector. 58° is the midpoint of the cited Urca/Sugarloaf/Leme sightline envelope, used as an explicitly estimated sector representative, not a measured optical axis. The frame does not locate the optical center within that sector.
cameras.fovReason: No trustworthy pixel correspondences for two distinct georeferenced terrain points could be established from the screenshot; the terrain silhouette identities and exact points on each ridge are ambiguous. Inferring FOV from apparent screen spacing would be fabricated.

symbolicCone.note: If a map display requires a graphic, use a dashed wedge spanning 41°–76° with arbitrary display length explicitly marked symbolic. It must not imply a visibility radius or calibrated FOV.
